description: Cups to grams for flour, sugar, butter, honey, and more. One converter per ingredient, with the weight per cup and a worked example.
intro: Cups measure volume and grams measure weight, and every ingredient has its own conversion between the two. A cup of flour weighs 120 grams. A cup of honey weighs 336 grams. Same cup, nearly three times the weight. That is why converting by ingredient matters, and why a single cups-to-grams number never works.

Each converter below is for one ingredient, with its own weight per cup from King Arthur Baking's ingredient weight chart. Type an amount in cups or grams and the answer updates as you type. The table underneath shows the common amounts at a glance, and the worked example shows the maths.
Start with the ingredient in your recipe. If it is not here yet, the full list of converters is on the tools page. More ingredients are added with each batch.
